formats.values.npy: Flat NumPy array of fixed-width ASCII byte strings. Each element preserves one original decimal literal and has NUL padding up to 16 bytes.
formats.vocabulary.tsv: UTF-8 TSV with a header and one zero-based row index per vocabulary token in source order.

lookup.scalar_index: 50 * word_row + dimension, with zero-based word_row and dimension.
lookup.source_line: word_row + 2 in the decompressed source text.
